dslRule:
<!id: region.includes.length.zero.fix>
<!description: Fix for AnnotationModel#isWithinRegion to correctly handle regions with length 0.
Replaces 'length - 1' with 'length - (length > 0 ? 1 : 0)' when used in fRegion.includes(start + length - 1) context.
This addresses a bug where a region of length 0 would attempt to include index -1.
>
<!severity: ERROR>

$fRegion.includes($start + $length - 1)
=>
$fRegion.includes($start + $length - ($length > 0 ? 1 : 0))
;;
summary: Replace incorrect boundary calculation for length 0 in region check.
